en: Black‑and‑white postcard view of a large military barracks complex with long, multi‑storey buildings lined with many identical windows and dormer roofs. In the foreground is a fenced entrance with gates and low pillars, opening onto a cobblestone street leading between the barracks blocks. Handwritten red numbers appear in the top right margin. Printed caption text in German runs along the bottom edge.
